```{r create map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


# 0. Load packages
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(htmlwidgets)


# 1. Load Data
data <- read.csv("./data/input/case_studies_with_coordinates.csv")

# 2. Coordinate Cleaning Logic
clean_coord <- function(val) {
  if (is.na(val)) return(NA)
  # Remove dots and convert to numeric
  s <- gsub("\\.", "", as.character(val))
  num <- as.numeric(s)
  
  # Apply scaling based on magnitude
  if (abs(num) > 100000) {
    return(num / 10000)
  } else {
    return(num / 1000)
  }
}

# Apply cleaning
data_clean <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lat = as.numeric(gsub("\\.", "", as.character(coord_Y))),
    lon = as.numeric(gsub("\\.", "", as.character(coord_X))))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat= ifelse(abs(lat) > 100000, lat / 10000, lat / 1000),
                lon= ifelse(abs(lon) > 100000, lon / 10000, lon / 1000))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(coord_Y=="−4.6083",-4.6083 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(coord_X=="´55.5136",55.5136 , lon)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(lat) & !is.na(lon))

# 3. Lump Categories
# I, M, C -> Control (Black)
# E, DE -> Eradication (Red)
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Category = case_when(
    trimws(measure) %in% c("C", "I", "M") ~ "Control",
    trimws(measure) %in% c("E", "DE") ~ "Eradication",
    TRUE ~ "Other"),
  Color = ifelse(Category == "Control", "black", "red"))

# 4. Create map
leaflet(data_clean) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  setView(lng = 174, lat = -40, zoom = 4) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, 
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 8,
    fillColor = ~Color,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1.5,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", Species, "</b><br>",
      "<hr>",
      "<b>Category:</b> ", Category, "<br>",
      "<b>Measure:</b> ", measure_full, "<br>",
      "<b>Location:</b> ", location, "<br>",
      "<b>Ref:</b> ", reference
    ),
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(
      spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE,
      showCoverageOnHover = FALSE,
      zoomToBoundsOnClick = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "topright",
    colors = c("black", "red"),
    labels = c("Control (C, I, M)", "Eradication (E, DE)"),
    title = "Management Category",
    opacity = 1
  )%>% htmlwidgets::onRender("
  function(el, x) {
    el.style.width = '100%';
    var map = this;
    map.setView([20, -15], 2);
  }
")


```
